Senior UI/UX Designer

New York, NY, USA · Hybrid · Promoted

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer who is passionate about creating intuitive, beautiful, and accessible digital experiences. You will be the lead designer for our consumer-facing mobile application, which serves over 2 million users.

Day-to-Day
- Lead end-to-end design processes: from wireframing and prototyping to high-fidelity visual design.
- Partner with user researchers to conduct usability testing and synthesize feedback into actionable iterations.
- Maintain, expand, and enforce our core Design System to ensure cross-platform consistency.
- Hand off pixel-perfect designs to frontend engineers and conduct design QA before launch.

Must-Haves
- A stunning portfolio demonstrating complex problem-solving and exquisite visual design skills.
- 4+ years of professional product design experience for mobile (iOS/Android) and web.
- Expert-level proficiency in Figma.
- Strong understanding of mobile design guidelines (Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design).
- Experience working in cross-functional squads (Product, Eng, Design).

Mobile App Developer (Flutter)

Dubai, United Arab Emirates · On-site · Entry Level

The Opportunity
Join a fast-growing travel tech startup in Dubai! We are building a super-app for global travelers and need an enthusiastic Mobile App Developer specializing in Flutter to help us ship features across both iOS and Android simultaneously.

What You Will Do
- Develop and maintain features for our primary Flutter application.
- Integrate third-party SDKs (Maps, Payment Gateways, Analytics).
- Consume RESTful APIs and handle local state management using Provider or Riverpod.
- Ensure smooth UI transitions, animations, and native-like performance.
- Assist in App Store and Google Play Store deployment processes.

Requirements
- 1-3 years of mobile development experience, with at least 1 year actively using Flutter and Dart.
- Solid understanding of mobile UI/UX principles.
- Experience with Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Crashlytics).
- Familiarity with native build tools (XCode, Android Studio) is a huge plus.

Senior Python Backend Engineer (Platform & AI Solutions)

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India · Hybrid · 3 days ago · Over 150 applicants
Promoted by hiring team · Fast-growing AI SaaS Platform

About the Company
At NexaScale AI, we are building next-generation enterprise infrastructure that bridges foundational AI models with real-time operational workflows. Headquartered in Bengaluru with offices in San Francisco, we power automated intelligence for Fortune 500 logistics and fintech clients globally. Our engineering culture values deep autonomy, pragmatic execution, and continuous technical growth.

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Python Backend Engineer to join our Core Platform squad. In this role, you will architect and scale high-throughput API services, asynchronous data processing pipelines, and direct integrations with Large Language Model (LLM) providers and vector databases.

What You Will Be Doing
- Core Architecture: Design, build, and maintain production-grade microservices using Python 3.11+, FastAPI, and Celery.
- Data Pipelines: Architect resilient, high-volume event processing flows using Apache Kafka, Redis, and PostgreSQL.
- AI Integration: Implement secure, low-latency API wrappers around LLM endpoints, optimizing prompt execution and response caching using Redis and Pgvector.
- Technical Ownership: Take end-to-end ownership of system modules from technical design and RFC creation through deployment, monitoring, and scaling.
- Quality & Reliability: Maintain high testing coverage (PyTest), establish automated CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions, and enforce strict code quality standards through automated linters and type checking (mypy).

What Makes You a Great Fit
Must-haves:
- 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong foundation in server-side Python.
- Deep familiarity with modern asynchronous Python frameworks (FastAPI, AsyncIO, Sanic, or Tornado).
- Strong expertise in SQL schema design, query optimization, and relational database internals (PostgreSQL/MySQL).
- Solid background in system design, microservices orchestration, and RESTful/gRPC API patterns.
- Proven ability to write clean, testable, and maintainable code with strict type annotations.

Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:
- High Agency: You thrive in ambiguous environments and take pride in taking problems from zero to production-ready solutions.
- Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting technical RFCs to cross-functional teams.
- Mentorship: Passion for elevating team members through constructive code reviews and technical mentoring.

Nice-to-haves:
- Prior experience working with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant) or LLM orchestrators (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
- Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS services (ECS, SQS, ElastiCache).
- Contributions to open-source Python projects or technical blogs.

What We Offer
- Competitive salary package with equity/stock options.
- Flexible hybrid work schedule (2 days in our Indiranagar office, 3 days remote).
- Comprehensive medical coverage for you and your dependents.
- Annual learning allowance for conferences, books, and certifications.

Lead Java Backend Engineer - High Volume Payments

Mumbai, Maharashtra, India · On-site · 1 week ago · Actively Hiring
Managed by Talent Acquisition Team

About the Business
FinPay Global is one of India's leading fintech infrastructure providers, processing over 12 million daily digital payment transactions across UPI, card networks, and cross-border remittances. As we scale our core banking integration suite, security, zero downtime, and sub-second latency remain our highest engineering priorities.

Opportunity Overview
We are seeking a Lead Java Backend Engineer to lead our Core Ledger & Settlement squad. You will be directly responsible for the architecture, security, and performance of our core transactional settlement engines that process billions of rupees daily.

Key Responsibilities
- System Design: Architect highly availability, fault-tolerant payment pipelines using Java 17/21, Spring Boot 3.x, and Spring Cloud.
- Concurrency & Performance: Optimize multi-threaded transaction engines, eliminating race conditions and ensuring ACID compliance across distributed datastores.
- Event-Driven Architecture: Implement event streaming pipelines using Apache Kafka for real-time reconciliation and fraud monitoring.
- Technical Leadership: Manage technical execution for a team of 5-7 engineers, driving sprint planning, code reviews, and architectural governance.
- Security & Compliance: Enforce strict PCI-DSS, RBI regulatory guidelines, and data encryption standards across all API interfaces.

Candidate Qualifications
Requirements:
- 8+ years of core backend engineering experience with strong expertise in Java (Java 11/17/21).
- Deep hands-on experience with the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA).
- Mastery of relational database management systems (Oracle DB, PostgreSQL) including query tuning, indexing, and deadlock resolution.
- Solid experience in event-driven systems using Kafka, RabbitMQ, or ActiveMQ.
- Hands-on background with memory profiling (JProfiler, YourKit), JVM tuning, and garbage collection analysis.

Soft Skills & Leadership Attributes:
- Problem-Solving: Ability to remain calm and decisive during high-severity production incidents.
- Collaboration: Strong cross-functional alignment with Product, Risk, and Compliance leadership teams.
- Accountable Mindset: Ownership of service SLAs (99.999% availability targets).

Bonus Points:
- Experience working within fintech, payment gateways, core banking platforms, or high-frequency trading.
- Knowledge of reactive programming (Project Reactor, RxJava, WebFlux).
- Experience migrating monolithic legacy applications to microservices on AWS/GCP.

Why Work With Us
- Opportunity to build infrastructure powering the digital payments backbone of India.
- Best-in-class compensation package with performance-linked annual bonuses.
- On-site wellness amenities, catered meals, and full family health cover.

Senior Go (Golang) Systems Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure

Gurgaon, Haryana, India · Remote · 4 days ago · 68 applicants
Distributed Team Setup · Fast-Growing Infrastructure Startup

Company Overview
CloudScale Network is building a next-generation distributed edge network that drastically reduces API latency for global applications. Our software runs on hundreds of bare-metal servers across 40+ global data centers. We are engineering-led, open-source friendly, and remote-first.

Role Focus
We are looking for a Senior Go Backend Engineer who loves low-level systems engineering, networking protocols, and extreme performance optimization. You will work on our control plane and edge proxy software written entirely in Go.

Your Responsibilities
- Edge Proxy Development: Write low-latency, high-throughput network services in Go utilizing gRPC, HTTP/3, and QUIC.
- Control Plane Architecture: Build distributed state-management services utilizing etcd, Raft consensus algorithms, and NAT traversal techniques.
- Resource Optimization: Profile and optimize Go code for memory allocation, GC pauses, and CPU consumption under multi-gigabit traffic loads.
- Observability: Instrument services with Prometheus metrics, OpenTelemetry distributed tracing, and structured logging.
- Automation: Build custom Kubernetes operators and CRDs in Go to automate cloud deployment patterns.

What We Are Looking For
Core Technical Skills:
- 4+ years of dedicated professional experience software development in Go (Golang).
- Strong knowledge of Go internals: Goroutine scheduler, channel patterns, garbage collection tuning, and unsafe/cgo mechanics.
- In-depth understanding of Linux networking, TCP/IP stack, sockets, HTTP/2, gRPC, and TLS handshakes.
- Practical experience with cloud-native tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform).
- Familiarity with distributed system concepts (CAP theorem, vector clocks, distributed locking).

Interpersonal & Soft Skills:
- Remote Execution: Self-starter who excels in async communication (Slack, GitHub, Notion).
- Pragmatic Engineering: Balancing theoretical elegance with practical, production-oriented solutions.
- Empathy: Respectful code review culture focused on constructive feedback.

Nice-to-Haves:
- Experience with eBPF, XDP, or Linux kernel networking.
- Background in Rust or C/C++ systems programming.
- Active participation or maintenance in open-source Go projects.

Perks & Culture
- 100% remote work policy with flexible working hours.
- Home office setup grant ($1,000 equivalent) + annual hardware upgrades.
- Unlimited PTO policy with mandatory minimum quarterly time off.

Principal Node.js / TypeScript Backend Architect

Hyderabad, Telangana, India · Hybrid · 2 days ago · 94 applicants
Global SaaS Leader · Enterprise Collaboration Platform

About the Organization
WorkSphere is a unified workplace communication and project management suite used by over 5 million daily active users. Our engineering team in Hyderabad is expanding to build the real-time collaboration engines that support live document editing, voice channels, and instant messaging.

Role Overview
We are seeking a Principal Backend Architect specializing in Node.js and TypeScript to lead the architectural evolution of our real-time messaging pipeline. You will be responsible for scaling services that handle millions of persistent WebSocket connections simultaneously.

Key Operational Responsibilities
- Architecture & Strategy: Set the long-term technical architecture for our Node.js microservices ecosystem, advocating for type-safety, modularity, and scalability.
- Real-Time Services: Design and scale socket-based server systems using Node.js, WebSockets, Socket.io, and Redis Pub/Sub.
- API Ecosystem: Oversee GraphQL and REST API schema design, federated graph architectures, and rate-limiting gateways.
- Database Engineering: Manage multi-tenant datastores using MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Redis caching networks.
- Developer Experience: Build internal tooling, core NPM packages, and boilerplate standards to boost productivity across 12+ engineering teams.

Qualifications & Requirements
- 10+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 5+ years building production Node.js services at scale.
- Mastery of TypeScript, Node.js event loop mechanics, stream processing, and asynchronous non-blocking I/O.
- Deep understanding of real-time communication protocols (WebSockets, WebRTC, Server-Sent Events).
- Proven experience designing and operating distributed systems on AWS (Lambda, ECS, DynamoDB, ElastiCache).
- Experience with GraphQL federation and schema stitching in large enterprise applications.

Leadership & Soft Skills:
- Strategic Vision: Ability to align technical roadmaps with business goals and executive strategies.
- Mentorship: History of coaching tech leads, staff engineers, and fostering technical career paths.
- Influence: Ability to build consensus across distributed engineering organizations without relying on direct authority.

Desirable Qualifications:
- Experience with serverless architectures and edge runtime platforms (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel).
- Knowledge of message brokers like NATS or Apache Kafka.

Benefits & Perks
- Industry-leading compensation with generous stock options (RSUs).
- Modern hybrid workspace in HITEC City, Hyderabad with transport allowance.
- Comprehensive parental leave, health insurance, and annual wellness subsidies.

Senior Rust Backend Engineer - Storage & Distributed Engines

Pune, Maharashtra, India · Remote · 5 days ago · 38 applicants
High-Performance Computing & Database Systems

Company Profile
VaultDB is a deep-tech startup building a next-generation, analytical, open-source columnar database engine designed for real-time telemetry analytics. We write zero-cost abstractions, care deeply about memory safety without garbage collection, and target sub-millisecond query execution over petabyte-scale datasets.

Position Summary
We are looking for a Senior Rust Backend Engineer to join our Core Query Engine team. You will spend your days writing idiomatic Rust code to implement distributed query planning, custom storage formats, and memory-mapped file indexing.

What You Will Work On
- Engine Core: Implement query execution operators, vectorization engines, and custom storage formats in Rust.
- Concurrency & Async: Build high-concurrency storage pipelines utilizing Tokio, async-std, and lock-free data structures.
- Benchmarking & Profiling: Conduct rigorous performance profiling (cargo flamegraph, perf, valgrind) to eliminate memory allocation bottlenecks and cache misses.
- API & Protocol Interfaces: Expose high-performance gRPC and Arrow Flight interfaces for client connectivity.
- Reliability: Write comprehensive integration test suites, property-based tests (proptest), and fuzz tests to guarantee zero data corruption.

Requirements & Technical Background
Must-Haves:
- 3+ years of professional or heavy open-source experience writing production Rust.
- Deep understanding of Rust concepts: ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, traits, unsafe Rust boundaries, and concurrency paradigms.
- Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals: memory layout, CPU cache hierarchies, OS I/O primitives, and file systems.
- Experience with asynchronous Rust runtimes (specifically Tokio).
- Familiarity with data structures used in databases (LSM trees, B+ trees, SkipLists, Bloom filters).

Personal Attributes & Soft Skills:
- Attention to Detail: Obsession with correctness, edge-case handling, and rigorous testing.
- Scientific Mindset: Relying on empirical benchmarks rather than assumptions when optimizing code performance.
- Self-Direction: Ability to break down complex architectural goals into executable technical milestones.

Nice to Have:
- Familiarity with Apache Arrow, DataFusion, or DuckDB internals.
- Prior experience with C/C++ database kernels or operating system design.
- Contributions to the Rust ecosystem or compiler tooling.

What We Offer
- Highly competitive compensation package with global pay parity.
- Flexible work-from-anywhere model with co-working space reimbursement in Pune or any metro city.
- Generous hardware allowance (M-series MacBook Pro / High-spec Linux workstation).
- Sponsorship for global Rust and database engineering conferences (RustConf, EuroRust).

Senior Go Backend Engineer - Core Microservices

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India · Hybrid · 2 days ago · 112 applicants
Series C E-Commerce Platform · Product Engineering Team

About the Company
UrbanCart is a rapidly scaling e-commerce ecosystem serving over 20 million active users across Southeast Asia and India. We are transitioning our legacy monolithic architecture into a highly resilient, globally distributed microservices mesh. Our engineering culture champions domain-driven design, robust testing, and blazingly fast APIs.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Go Backend Engineer to anchor our Core Checkout & Cart squad. You will be building user-facing product APIs that must handle immense traffic spikes during flash sales without compromising data consistency or latency.

Your Responsibilities
- Microservices Architecture: Design, build, and deploy high-performance REST and gRPC microservices entirely in Go.
- Monolith Decomposition: Work alongside Staff Engineers to securely strangle the legacy Ruby on Rails monolith and migrate critical checkout logic to the new Go ecosystem.
- Database Design: Architect scalable schemas using PostgreSQL; implement intelligent caching layers using Redis to ensure sub-50ms API response times.
- API Contracts: Define strict protobuf definitions and OpenAPI specifications to ensure seamless integration with mobile and frontend engineering teams.
- Production Readiness: Implement comprehensive unit, integration, and load tests using Go's built-in testing framework and tools like k6.

Qualifications & Requirements
Core Technical Skills:
- 5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years heavily focused on Go (Golang) in production.
- Deep understanding of Go idioms, interfaces, concurrent programming (goroutines, waitgroups, channels), and context management.
- Strong expertise in relational database design, transactional integrity (ACID), and handling distributed transactions (Saga pattern).
- Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS deployment patterns.

Soft Skills & Behavioral Attributes:
- Cross-Team Collaboration: Exceptional ability to communicate API limitations and architectural tradeoffs to Product Managers and mobile developers.
- Mentorship: A track record of upskilling mid-level engineers through paired programming and rigorous code reviews.
- Customer-Centric: Deep empathy for the end-user experience, recognizing that an API timeout means a lost customer.

Nice-to-Haves:
- Experience dealing with high-traffic e-commerce flash sales or ticket-booking systems.
- Knowledge of GraphQL federation.

What We Offer
- Competitive base pay + annual performance bonus + ESOPs.
- Relocation assistance to Bengaluru.
- Hybrid work model (3 days in our Koramangala office, 2 days remote).
- Catered lunches and a comprehensive medical insurance plan for your family.

Platform Engineer (Golang) - Internal Developer Platform

Remote, India · Full-Time · Actively Hiring
Global FinTech SaaS · Developer Productivity Engineering

Company Profile
PayStream is an international B2B payments gateway. To support our engineering organization of 500+ developers, our Developer Productivity Engineering (DPE) team is building a self-service Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that abstracts away cloud complexity and accelerates deployment velocity.

Role Focus
We are seeking a Platform Engineer who is passionate about building tools for other developers. You will write Go code not for end-users, but to automate infrastructure, build custom Kubernetes controllers, and create powerful CLI tools that our engineering organization will use daily.

Key Responsibilities
- CLI & Tooling: Build and maintain lightning-fast command-line interfaces (CLIs) in Go using libraries like Cobra and Viper to streamline the developer experience.
- Kubernetes Automation: Develop custom Kubernetes Operators and Controllers (using client-go and Kubebuilder) to automate database provisioning, TLS certificate issuance, and service meshes.
- Infrastructure as Code: Write Go applications that programmatically interact with Terraform and AWS APIs to dynamically spin up ephemeral testing environments.
- CI/CD Pipelines: Optimize our GitLab CI/CD pipelines to ensure code goes from a pull request to production in under 15 minutes safely.
- Telemetry: Instrument internal platforms with OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing and performance bottleneck identification.

Candidate Profile
Technical Requirements:
- 4+ years of backend or platform engineering experience, with strong proficiency in Go.
- Deep, hands-on experience with Kubernetes internals, Helm, and container orchestration.
- Strong scripting and automation skills (Bash, Makefiles).
- Thorough understanding of Cloud Infrastructure (AWS or GCP) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
- Familiarity with CI/CD tools (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

Interpersonal & Soft Skills:
- Developer Empathy: You treat internal engineers as your customers and are deeply invested in improving their daily workflows.
- Asynchronous Communication: Ability to write exceptional technical documentation, runbooks, and architectural decision records (ADRs).
- High Autonomy: Capable of self-managing project timelines in a fully remote, distributed team environment.

Nice to Have:
- Prior experience building Backstage plugins or working with ArgoCD/Flux (GitOps).
- Open-source contributions to CNCF projects (Kubernetes, Prometheus, Envoy).

Perks & Benefits
- 100% remote-first culture with an annual co-working stipend.
- Bi-annual company retreats (Previous locations: Bali, Goa, Lisbon).
- $1,500 annual home office setup allowance.
- Unlimited access to Udemy, O'Reilly, and paid cloud certifications.

Go Backend Engineer - High-Frequency Streaming

Pune, Maharashtra, India · On-site · 1 week ago · 45 applicants
AdTech Data Infrastructure · Real-Time Bidding Team

About the Organization
AdVantage is a programmatic advertising platform that processes over 100 billion ad requests daily. In our world, latency is directly tied to revenue. Our infrastructure must evaluate user telemetry, run auction algorithms, and serve an ad within 100 milliseconds.

Position Summary
We need a hard-core Go Backend Engineer to join our Real-Time Bidding (RTB) engine team. You will be designing high-throughput, latency-critical data streaming pipelines that ingest, transform, and route massive streams of telemetry data.

What You Will Do
- Streaming Pipelines: Build and optimize high-throughput event ingestion services using Go and Apache Kafka.
- Low-Latency Engineering: Optimize server-side bidding logic to consistently meet strict p99 latency SLAs (<20ms) under unpredictable load spikes.
- Datastore Optimization: Interface with highly available NoSQL databases (Aerospike, ScyllaDB/Cassandra) for lightning-fast user profile lookups.
- Memory Profiling: Relentlessly profile Go applications (pprof, trace) to optimize memory layouts, minimize garbage collection pauses, and reduce CPU overhead.
- Resilience: Design graceful degradation and circuit breaker mechanisms to ensure the system remains available even when downstream data partners fail.

What We Are Looking For
Core Tech Qualifications:
- 3-6 years of software engineering experience, focusing on high-performance backend systems in Go.
- Exceptional grasp of data structures, algorithmic complexity (Big-O), and low-level system performance tuning.
- Extensive experience with message brokers and event streaming platforms, especially Apache Kafka.
- Familiarity with high-performance NoSQL/Key-Value stores (Aerospike, Redis, Cassandra).
- Solid background in Linux systems engineering and network protocol optimization (TCP/UDP, Protocol Buffers).

Soft Skills & Traits:
- Analytical Rigor: You approach performance bottlenecks scientifically, relying on metrics and profiling tools rather than guesswork.
- Pressure Resilience: Ability to remain focused and methodical during high-stakes production incidents.
- Continuous Learner: Passionate about reading engineering blogs, whitepapers, and staying updated on the latest optimizations in the Go runtime.

Bonus Qualifications:
- Previous experience in AdTech, Real-Time Bidding (RTB), or High-Frequency Trading (HFT).
- Experience with columnar data formats (Parquet) and data warehousing (ClickHouse).

Why Join Us
- Work on engineering problems at a scale few companies in India can offer.
- Highly competitive base salary designed to attract top-tier systems engineering talent.
- Comprehensive relocation package to Pune.
- Monthly hackathons and a heavily sponsored continuous learning budget.

Mid-Level Java Backend Engineer (Microservices)

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India · Hybrid · 2 days ago · 89 applicants
Growth-Stage Retail Tech · Core Platform Team

About the Company
RetailSync is building the operating system for modern omnichannel retail. Our platform connects inventory, point-of-sale, and e-commerce storefronts in real-time. We move fast, value clean code, and empower our engineers to take ownership of the features they build.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Mid-Level Java Engineer to join our Core Platform Team. You will be instrumental in building out new microservices to handle our growing merchant base, focusing on building scalable, well-tested APIs that our frontend and mobile teams rely on.

Key Responsibilities
- API Development: Design and implement robust RESTful APIs using Java 17 and Spring Boot 3.
- Database Integration: Write efficient queries and manage schema changes using PostgreSQL and Hibernate/JPA.
- System Architecture: Participate in transitioning legacy monolithic modules into modular, independently deployable microservices.
- Testing & CI/CD: Write comprehensive unit and integration tests using JUnit 5 and Mockito; ensure smooth deployments via Jenkins and Docker.
- Collaboration: Work closely with Product Managers and Frontend Engineers to define API contracts and resolve integration issues.

Qualifications & Requirements
Core Technical Skills:
- 3-5 years of professional software development experience focused on backend Java.
- Strong proficiency in Java (11/17) and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data).
- Solid understanding of SQL and relational database design.
- Experience with containerization (Docker) and version control (Git).

Soft Skills & Behavioral Attributes:
- Team Player: You thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy participating in agile ceremonies.
- Problem Solver: A knack for debugging complex issues and tracing bugs across distributed systems.
- Growth Mindset: Eager to learn new tools and share knowledge with peers.

Benefits
- Competitive salary and performance bonuses.
- Hybrid work model (3 days office, 2 days remote).
- Comprehensive health insurance for employees and dependents.
- Annual budget for courses and technical certifications.

Senior Java Software Engineer - High-Throughput Payments

Mumbai, Maharashtra, India · On-site · 5 days ago · 140 applicants
Global FinTech · Payment Gateway division

About the Business
PaySphere handles millions of financial transactions daily, routing payments globally with sub-second latency. Reliability, strict consistency, and absolute security are the pillars of our engineering culture. 

Opportunity Overview
We need a Senior Java Backend Engineer who lives and breathes high-concurrency, low-latency systems. You will work on our core transactional engine, where every millisecond of performance optimization translates directly to business value.

Your Responsibilities
- Transaction Engine: Build and maintain core payment processing microservices using Java 21, ensuring strict ACID compliance.
- Concurrency Management: Write highly optimized, thread-safe code, leveraging Java's concurrency utilities and Virtual Threads (Project Loom) to handle massive request volumes.
- Event Streaming: Design scalable, fault-tolerant asynchronous workflows using Apache Kafka for fraud detection and ledger reconciliation.
- Security: Enforce strict PCI-DSS compliance, implement robust encryption payloads, and secure APIs using OAuth2 and Spring Security.
- Performance Tuning: Profile JVM performance, tune garbage collection, and optimize database queries across Oracle and Apache Cassandra.

Candidate Qualifications
Requirements:
- 6+ years of heavy Java backend experience, preferably in fintech, banking, or high-frequency trading.
- Deep mastery of JVM internals, memory management, and multithreading paradigms.
- Extensive experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and distributed caching (Redis/Hazelcast).
- Solid understanding of event-driven architectures and message brokers (Kafka/RabbitMQ).

Soft Skills & Traits:
- Meticulous & Detail-Oriented: You understand that a single edge-case bug in financial software can cause catastrophic damage.
- Calm Under Pressure: Ability to logically troubleshoot and resolve high-severity production outages.
- Mentorship: Proven track record of elevating the engineering standards of your team through code reviews and architecture design sessions.

What We Offer
- Top-of-market compensation package.
- Dedicated innovation time (10% of sprint capacity).
- Premium on-site facilities including gym, cafeteria, and wellness center.

Lead Java Backend Engineer (Modernization & Cloud Migration)

Pune, Maharashtra, India · Hybrid · 1 week ago · 65 applicants
Enterprise Healthcare Solutions

Company Profile
Medisys Tech is a leading provider of electronic health record (EHR) systems in India and Southeast Asia. We are currently embarking on a massive modernization initiative to move our flagship on-premise product to a cloud-native SaaS model.

Role Focus
As a Lead Java Engineer, you will spearhead the migration of our legacy Java EE monolith into a modern, Kubernetes-orchestrated microservices mesh. You will bridge the gap between historical business logic and cutting-edge cloud infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities
- Monolith Decomposition: Architect the secure decoupling of a 10-year-old Java EE monolith into domain-driven Spring Boot microservices.
- Cloud Architecture: Design and deploy secure, HIPAA-compliant backend services on AWS utilizing EKS, RDS, and S3.
- Technical Leadership: Manage technical deliverables for a pod of 6 engineers. Drive agile rituals, technical debt reduction, and sprint planning.
- Data Migration: Oversee the complex migration of massive healthcare datasets from legacy Oracle servers to managed PostgreSQL instances without data loss.
- Quality Assurance: Institute mandatory static analysis (SonarQube), strict code coverage thresholds, and automated security vulnerability scanning.

What We Are Looking For
Core Technical Skills:
- 8+ years of enterprise Java development experience.
- Deep historical knowledge of Java EE, Servlets, and older application servers (WebSphere/Tomcat) combined with modern Spring Boot expertise.
- Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes deployment strategies.
- Strong architectural knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and strangler fig patterns.

Leadership & Soft Skills:
- Change Management: Ability to lead a team through complex architectural shifts while maintaining morale and productivity.
- Cross-functional Communication: Excellent ability to explain technical debt and refactoring timelines to non-technical business stakeholders.
- Empathy: Respect for legacy code and the developers who wrote it, with a focus on constructive modernization.

Perks & Benefits
- Competitive salary with structured annual increments.
- Comprehensive family health insurance, including parental cover.
- Hybrid flexibility and generous paid time off.

Principal Java Architect - Distributed Systems

Gurgaon, Haryana, India · Remote · 3 days ago · 42 applicants
Global Supply Chain & Logistics Network

About the Organization
RouteOptima processes complex logistics routing algorithms for over 5,000 fleets globally. Our systems must ingest real-time geospatial data, weather APIs, and traffic updates to calculate optimal delivery routes on the fly.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Principal Java Architect to define the technical vision for our global routing engine. This is a hands-on, high-level role where you will divide your time between writing highly complex proof-of-concepts, reviewing system architecture, and guiding the engineering strategy across multiple squads.

Operational Responsibilities
- Architectural Vision: Design highly scalable, event-sourced distributed architectures using Java 17+, Apache Flink, and Kafka to process millions of geospatial events per minute.
- System Resilience: Implement advanced distributed system patterns (CQRS, Event Sourcing, Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads) to ensure zero-downtime tolerance.
- Technical Governance: Establish organization-wide standards for API design (gRPC/REST), observability (OpenTelemetry), and asynchronous messaging.
- Optimization: Lead the optimization of complex routing algorithms, reducing computational overhead and AWS infrastructure costs.
- Cross-Team Influence: Act as the ultimate technical escalation point for 5+ engineering squads, mentoring Staff and Lead engineers.

Qualifications & Requirements
- 12+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 4 years in an Architect or Principal role.
- Mastery of the Java ecosystem, distributed computing, and data-intensive applications.
- Deep understanding of distributed databases (Cassandra, DynamoDB), geospatial indexing, and graph databases (Neo4j).
- Extensive experience designing cloud-native solutions on AWS or GCP.

Interpersonal & Leadership Skills:
- Technical Evangelism: Ability to inspire engineering teams and drive the adoption of new paradigms and technologies.
- Business Acumen: Ability to translate complex supply chain business requirements into concrete architectural blueprints.
- Exceptional Documentation: Writing clear, comprehensive Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and whitepapers for internal teams.

Benefits
- Top-tier executive compensation package including generous RSUs.
- 100% remote working flexibility with regular all-expenses-paid offsites.
- Unlimited PTO and dedicated learning budget.

Junior Java Backend Developer

Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India · On-site · 2 weeks ago · Over 200 applicants
EdTech Startup

Company Profile
EduLaunch is an innovative EdTech startup on a mission to make quality technical education accessible across rural India. We are building a lightweight, highly accessible learning management system (LMS).

Position Summary
We are looking for an enthusiastic, entry-level Java Backend Developer. This is a fantastic opportunity to be mentored by senior engineers, write production code, and learn how scalable applications are built from the ground up.

What You Will Do
- Feature Development: Build and maintain core features of our LMS, such as user authentication, quiz grading engines, and progress tracking, using Java and Spring Boot.
- Database Management: Write fundamental SQL queries and learn to optimize database interactions using Spring Data JPA.
